block.human_approval.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.human_approval.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.human_approval.model.title: Human Approval
block.human_approval.model.description: Review a precise request, edit explicitly allowed fields and publish an approval only once for its current revision.
block.human_approval.transport_error: Unable to submit the decision. Check the runtime log.
block.human_approval.help_fields: Trusted editable fields, e.g. {"comment":{"type":"text","required":false}}. Types: text, number, boolean. Incoming requests can only reduce this list.
block.human_approval.help_timeout_sec: Decision deadline from receipt in seconds. Expired or replaced requests can never be approved.
block.human_approval.help_max_requests: Maximum distinct requests remembered during one Run. No silent eviction of replay protection.
block.human_approval.help_max_bytes: Maximum JSON bytes per request or corrected content; no attached file bytes.
block.human_approval.run_first: Start Active Runtime to review requests.
block.human_approval.replaced: Request replaced; review the new content.
block.human_approval.uncertain: Submission sent. Wait for runtime confirmation before retrying.
block.human_approval.missing: Fill every required field with a valid value.
